11	        parsed = date.fromisoformat(value)

13	        raise ValueError(value) from None
14	    if parsed.isoformat() != value:
15	        raise ValueError(value)

19	def anniversary(purchased: date) -> date:
20	    """購買日起滿一年；次年沒有 2 月 29 日時採 2 月最後一天。"""
21	    year = purchased.year + 1
22	    day = purchased.day
23	    if purchased.month == 2 and day == 29:
24	        day = 28
25	    return date(year, purchased.month, day)

33	    )
34	    args = parser.parse_args()
35	
36	    try:

38	    except ValueError as exc:
39	        print(f"無法使用的日期值：{exc.args[0]}", file=sys.stderr)
40	        return 2

43	        last_day = anniversary(purchase) - timedelta(days=1)
44	        if repair < purchase:

49	            days_over = (repair - last_day).days
50	            print(
51	                f"第 {index} 筆：已過保 {days_over} 天；"
52	                f"保固最後一天為 {last_day.isoformat()}。"
